roles.name: DJ
roles.power: Drop the beat: everyone else dances on the spot for a few seconds
roles.weakness: Very visible, gives away your position

roles.name: Teleporter
roles.power: Swaps the positions of 2 random players (maybe you)
roles.weakness: You don't choose who: it can help a killer

roles.name: Medic
roles.power: Puts a bubble on the closest player: it blocks one kill
roles.weakness: Everyone sees the bubble, it doesn't last

roles.name: Prankster
roles.power: Drops a banana peel. Whoever steps on it slips across the room
roles.weakness: Killers slip too… or use it to escape

roles.name: Gambler
roles.power: Spins the wheel once: a random player dies, then a random dead player comes back
roles.weakness: Totally random, everyone sees the wheel

roles.name: Sacrifice
roles.power: Next to a body: you die and they come back to life
roles.weakness: You're gone for good, only once

roles.name: Canadian
roles.power: Passive: if you get killed, your body reports itself. Sorry!
roles.weakness: You have to die first, eh

roles.name: Jester
roles.power: You win alone if you get voted out. Prank call: one emergency meeting from anywhere

roles.name: Vulture
roles.power: Eat bodies before anyone reports them. Eat enough and you win alone
roles.weakness: Eating destroys evidence: everyone hates you

roles.name: Blackout
roles.power: Cuts the lights: everyone but killers barely sees anything
roles.weakness: Everyone knows a killer did it

roles.name: Shapeshifter
roles.power: Takes the look and name of a random player for a while
roles.weakness: Two of the same person is a bit suspicious

roles.name: Swapper
roles.power: Swaps your position with a random innocent
roles.weakness: Random target, there's a puff of smoke at both spots

roles.name: Prop Master
roles.power: Drops a fake body that looks like a random living player
roles.weakness: The 'victim' is alive at the meeting
